summary: Full backend + frontend verification of the new Tasks features: (1) 'overdue' status value, (2) reminder_at/reminder_fired fields, (3) edit modal, (4) Hatırlat submenu with 5 presets + custom datetime picker, (5) reminder scheduler firing. Backend: 22/22 pytest tests pass (added 6 new tests: TestTasksOverdueStatus + TestTasksReminder covering all reminder edge cases — auto-reset of reminder_fired on reminder_at change, null clears, explicit reminder_fired=true, POST with reminder_at). Frontend: Verified via Playwright end-to-end — menu items adapt to task status (ctx-pending correctly hidden when task is pending), ctx-overdue flips status and card turns red with 'SÜRESİ GEÇTİ' badge, edit modal opens/saves title, Hatırlat submenu shows all 5 presets + custom input + KAYDET, 30m preset sets task.reminder_at with 'HATIRLATMA: ...' row on card, ctx-reminder-cancel clears it (and only appears when reminder is set), custom datetime input via page.fill+KAYDET works, and the reminder scheduler DOES fire — created task via API with reminder_at=now+3s, waited ~25s, verified server flipped reminder_fired to true and the card renders with dimmed bell + ✓. All features from the review request are working end-to-end.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend PATCH /api/tasks/{id} correctly auto-resets reminder_fired=false when reminder_at is changed but reminder_fired is not explicitly passed — verified via test_patch_sets_reminder_and_resets_fired.

Reminder scheduler window is now-5min..now (line 540 TasksPanel.jsx: `when <= now && when > now - 5*60*1000`). A task with reminder_at older than 5 minutes will NEVER fire (e.g., if user closes the tab and reopens 10 min later). Consider firing anything past-due-and-not-fired, or extending the window. Not a bug per requirements, but a UX gap for offline users.
useReminderScheduler check interval is 20s (line 546). Reminders can fire up to ~20s late; acceptable but worth noting. First check runs immediately on mount which is correct.
playReminderBeep opens a new AudioContext every fire — could accumulate in long sessions but is quickly garbage-collected in practice. Not blocking.
TasksPanel.jsx is now 818 lines — over the 700-line guideline. Consider extracting ContextMenu, EditTaskModal, TaskCard, and useReminderScheduler into their own files for maintainability.
EditTaskModal saveEdit sends due_date: null when field cleared — but backend PATCH TaskUpdate uses exclude_unset so explicit null WILL clear. Correct behavior verified.
The ContextMenu portal fix from iteration_7/8 still holds — verified visually (menu opens next to 3-dot button, submenu renders correctly).

success_rate.frontend: 14/14 assertions = 100% (menu items adapt, ctx-overdue, edit modal, 5 presets present, ctx-reminder-30m, ctx-reminder-cancel visibility & effect, custom reminder via fill+KAYDET, scheduler fires within 25s and reminder_fired flips server-side)
